species: To isolate RPIA for analysis, 1 × 106 HEK293 cells with suppressed PKR expression (as previously reported (Liu et al,)) were transfected with the complementary split Venus-tagged PKR and RPIA constructs (100 ng and 500 ng, respectively, in lipofectamine reagent) in a 5 cm dish.
